an6.104:1.1: 104 cha bhikkhave ānisaṃse sampassamānena alameva bhikkhunā sabbadhammesu anodhiṃ karitvā anattasaññaṃ upaṭṭhapetuṃ
an6.104:1.3: sabbaloke ca atammayo bhavissāmi ahaṃkārā ca me uparujjhissanti mamaṃkārā ca uparujjhissanti asādhāraṇena ca ñāṇena samannāgato bhavissāmi hetu ca me sudiṭṭho bhavissati hetusamuppannā ca dhammā
an6.104:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave cha ānisaṃse sampassamānena alameva bhikkhunā sabbadhammesu anodhiṃ karitvā anattasaññaṃ upaṭṭhapetunti.
